tagline: Why heart-drug trials fail, and what it means for the next drug.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

zetaris.role: Data layer and SQL fact checks
zetaris.how: ClinicalTrials.gov, Europe PMC and SEC EDGAR are read through a local Zetaris instance: each request becomes a Zetaris REST session table read back with Lightning SQL. For the literature the as_of cut-off runs inside that SQL, so papers published after the cut-off never reach the agents. The Verifier has Nemotron write one Lightning SQL query per number the calculator used, over the registry record and the cited papers; code guards the SQL, Zetaris runs it, and Nemotron judges each number confirmed, not found or contradicts. A contradiction goes to the critic, which can send the work back. Across the 26 recorded analyses: 95 numbers checked, 63 confirmed, 28 not found, 4 contradictions.

meterless.role: Power: Meterless Nightshift is the primary model provider. Build: the official World Model engine stores every source, entity and fact with provenance
meterless.how: Nightshift: the app calls Nightshift's OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the runtime token, the meterless-app and meterless-scope headers and a routing mode chosen per step in Settings; the NVIDIA key stays in Nightshift. In the 26 recorded runs 228 of the 233 reasoning calls went through Nightshift, answered by NVIDIA Nemotron; 5 went to NVIDIA directly after Nightshift cut the same request twice (its first-token limit, which Meterless is making configurable after my report). I reported a Nightshift bug with its fix (github.com/Meterless/Meterless/issues/4), fixed by Meterless the same night, and documented the Nightshift settings a strict pipeline needs (tier-split off, app bound to fast; extraction calls NVIDIA directly because the reasoning switch is not passed on). World Model: the official reference engine, unchanged, passes its conformance suite 8/8 and runs as a local service; every source, entity and fact is stored with provenance (563 entities, 2,176 facts, 639 links across the 26 analyses).

nvidia.how: Every AI step runs on NVIDIA Nemotron (3 Ultra and 3.5 Super). Blind backtest on 24 finished trials: outcome 13/16 where the trial could be sized, experts' main cause 14/24, cause among those named 21/24, expected hazard ratio within 0.03 of the answer key 13/20. Open models, so a company can run the same analysis on its own hardware, for example an NVIDIA DGX Spark.

open_source.langgraph: The pipeline graph (app/graph.py), with a conditional edge so the critic can send work back.

run.setup: See README: pip install -r requirements.txt, npm --prefix services/meterless install, then python run.py; scripts/smoke_test.py checks every layer.
run.offline_demo: SAMPLE_MODE=true replays the recorded runs with no keys and no network.

evidence: logs/ (step logs and World Model audit logs of the 26 recorded runs)
